camel_example: aliyun dts DescribeDtsServiceLog --region cn-hangzhou --Status 'NORMAL,WARN,ERROR' --DtsJobId c1yr56py1030000 --PageSize 20 --EndTime 1620897227000 --Keyword 'state_=_IDLE' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --PageNumber 1 --ZeroEtlJob true --StartTime 1620896327000 --SubJobType SYNC_WRITER --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the log information of a data migration or synchronization task
description_zh: 调用DescribeDtsServiceLog查询一个数据迁移或同步任务的日志信息
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-dts-service-log --dts-job-id c1yr56py1030000 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --start-time 1620896327000 --end-time 1620897227000 --status NORMAL,WARN,ERROR --sub-job-type SYNC_WRITER --keyword state_=_IDLE --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDtsServiceLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The number of log entries per page. Valid values: 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录的日志信息的数量，取值：20、50、100、500、1000，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the log information.

To query the log information of a DTS subtask within a specific time range, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html to query the execution time of the DTS subtask.
The start time is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter
parameters.help_zh:
日志信息的起始时间。

如需查询特定时间范围内DTS子任务执行的日志信息，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html查询DTS子任务的执行时间。
起始时间的格式为13位Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。Unix时间戳转换工具可用搜索引擎获取
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the log information. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html to query the end time.
To query the log information of a DTS subtask within a specific time range, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html to query the execution time of the DTS subtask.
The time is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp converter
parameters.help_zh:
日志信息的截止时间，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html进行查询。
如需查询特定时间范围内DTS子任务执行的日志信息，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209718.html查询DTS子任务的执行时间。
起始时间的格式为13位Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。Unix时间戳转换工具可用搜索引擎获取
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The log level of the log information. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:

NORMAL: Normal.
WARN: Warning.
ERROR: Error
parameters.help_zh:
日志信息的日志级别，多个状态以英文逗号（,）分隔，取值为：

NORMAL：正常。
WARN：报警。
ERROR：报错
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DTS task subnode. Valid values:


DATA_LOAD: full data migration or initial full data synchronization.
ONLINE_WRITER: incremental data migration.
SYNC_WRITER: incremental data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
DTS任务的具体子任务类型，取值为：


DATA_LOAD：全量迁移或全量同步。
ONLINE_WRITER：增量迁移。
SYNC_WRITER：增量同步
parameters.name: sub_job_type

parameters.help_en:
The keyword used to filter query results.
Fuzzy match is used and the keyword is case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
传入关键词，指定查询内容。
模糊匹配且区分大小写
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be deprecated
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en: The dynamic error message used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage parameter
DynamicMessage.description_zh: 动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of log entries per page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 每页记录的日志信息的数量

ServiceLogContexts.description_en: The task logs details of the node

Context.example: Statistics: generator = 369173; collector = 470109; replicator = 2470; ping = 2/2/2; execute = 29/29/29; rt = 29/29/29; state = IDLE; queries = -1; exceptions = {connects = 0, replicates = 0}; infos = {}

State.description_en: The status of the log entry

Time.description_en: The time when the log was collected, in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
Time.description_zh: 日志采集时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of log entries that meet the specified conditions
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 符合条件的日志信息的总数
